findings.finding: The acceptance receipt's hard-coded defect_id remains EXT-D-0042, while the reviewed defect and diagnostic report identify EXT-D-0143. A new receipt from this driver can be mislabeled.

passed_checks: Probe enters the actual acceptance driver's top-level catch and finally receipt writer, sets status unverified and process exitCode 1, and exposes only the safe category rather than the synthetic raw error.
Production samples only fixed-key counts and booleans; count values are range/type checked and unknown keys, strings, URLs, selectors and error text are discarded.
Probe assertions verify distinct click/scope failure codes and receipt observations; they do not assert a passing native outcome or promote scope.
Resource boundary refusal is mapped to a safe category. Sampling failure is contained and leaves observations absent rather than replacing the original failure.
limits: Probe injects before browser setup and supplies synthetic counts; it proves driver catch/receipt integration and mapping, not DOM sampling or native selection behavior.
The original error object is intentionally not persisted or printed; the failure remains visible through unverified status, nonzero exit and stage-specific code.
